scope.species_goal: All 649 Generation 1–5 species remain a future goal. These 96 encounter proposals do not establish all-species availability.
scope.type_system: Generation V; no Fairy type, Mega Evolution, or later-generation mechanics.
scope.original_npc_policy: Preserve all original dialogue except the minimum story-consistency replacements approved for the N/Alder arc. Exact original entries and hashes require the supplied ROM and the parent-owned strict dialogue guard; no blanket rewrite authorization.
scope.base_rom_status: User-supplied IREO revision 0 base is hash-pinned in toolchain-lock.json and passed a read-only dialogue baseline; base-world gate migration is specified, not implemented.
scope.integration_status: No engine IDs resolved, no patch built, no maps inserted, no playable slice claimed.
scope.campaign_access_policy: All 24 new settlements, 96 secrets, 12 additional gyms, species encounters, items and upgrades are available during the main campaign before N’s final Champion battle. No exclusive world or collectible reward requires defeating N.

intended_new_area_count.note: 120 settlement/secret nodes, plus 12 proposed gym interiors and 40 route connections. Counts describe design records, not allocated engine maps.

plot.premise: Rediscover a neglected network of rest refuges by observing Pokémon habits and comparing keepers' notes.
arc: Six early-to-late story detours recover marks for rest, warmth, water, safe banks, calm air, and coastal guidance.
An optional ledger comparison reveals two missing pages alongside the integrated twenty-gym main campaign.
Late-campaign surveys restore northern refuges and add a seasonal appendix.
A final exit survey reconnects the guide; its last page stays open for future visitors.
plot.stakes: Give travelers and Pokémon suitable places to rest, with clear paths back. No new crisis, villain takeover, or dependency for the main story.
plot.completion: All twelve quests are completable without catching any rare encounter.

authoring_rules.condition_semantics: all_of is conjunctive. gate_id reads a base-progress predicate; quest_complete_id reads that quest's completion flag; quest_started_id reads accepted-or-later status; flag_id reads an authored boolean.
authoring_rules.unresolved_binding_policy: Every map, script, flag, warp, landing, and dialogue identifier is semantic. National Dex IDs and levels are design data, not engine slot assignments.
authoring_rules.stage_semantics: Stages advance in listed order. Ordinary observation stages can use previously recorded notes. Stages explicitly marked post_acceptance require fresh, idempotent observations after accepting that quest. No encounter or capture satisfies an observation automatically.
authoring_rules.stage_completion_rule_status: Named completion rules are authoring intents awaiting implementation; only the first slice has detailed transition contracts.
authoring_rules.secret_policy: Discovery clues are repeatable. Exits are always usable once entered. Later encounter gates never block a room's observation objects.
authoring_rules.balance_policy: Low-stage visitors use local progression levels. High-power evolved and legendary/mythical encounters use late-campaign story, original Gym and observation requirements, all completable before N. Final levels and catch pacing await playtests.
authoring_rules.season_policy: Season and time change atmosphere or normal forms only, not required availability. Archive sketches satisfy the seasonal investigation.
authoring_rules.geography: Four geographic entry routes and a continuous looped network; physical exits remain available. Forward travel observes destination base-progress gates to prevent bypassing the original journey.
authoring_rules.gym_progression: emblem_id tests a separate expansion victory record; never infer or allocate additional vanilla badge bits. Storage, UI and save compatibility remain unresolved.

stages.objective: Speak to Mara and agree to look at the old shelter.
Inspect the berry skins, hoofprints, and two-leaf marker in any order.
Enter Leaffold Alcove and read the shelter board; battling Deerling is optional.
Tell Mara that the low entrance keeps the resting space quiet.

reward.finding: The leaf mark identifies a resting place, not buried treasure.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Compare the kiln vent and fan loft; record which draft reaches the small bell.
Trace the tapline to the curtained nook; read the rest schedule.
Explain to Nell that the soft bell signaled a quiet, warm resting space.

reward.finding: The bell mark records safe warmth and quiet hours.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Follow dew from roof to vault, then compare the buried steps with the wind marks.
Read the seedroom shade chart and the cellar water record.
Show Orrin that the route marked reliable drinking places rather than the shortest path.

reward.finding: The drop mark joins cool shade to reliable water.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Read the flood marks at Oxbow Hide and Driftroot Pocket.
Compare the reed pipe and still sluice; record the sheltered channel.
Help Fenn mark the bank path above the old flood line.

reward.finding: The reed mark follows a safe bank, leaving the water habitat undisturbed.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Compare the loft ribbon with the warm nesting box.
Walk the padded gallery and read the blue kite's knot guide.
Show Iva how low ribbons indicate calm paths for small or nervous Pokémon.

reward.finding: The thread mark records shelter from noise and strong wind.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Read the permanent dry-ledge marks and examine the rolled net.
Compare the warm seep with the lamp reflection at the service door.
Help Tobin mark a shore walk that avoids the nesting ledges and deep pools.

reward.finding: The lamp mark separates a walking route from the spaces water Pokémon need.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Bring the six automatically recorded marks to Mara's ledger table.
Compare the low doorway, soft bell, cool water, safe bank, quiet beam, and shielded lamp.
Identify a network of refuges maintained for different travelers; note two missing northern pages.

reward.finding: The six marks form a guide to suitable resting places, with two missing pages.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Compare the steam-root bed, snow-line scratches, and hearth pebbles.
Read the cold-room diagram at Winterseed Refuge without requiring its rare visitor.
Help Rusk restore separate warm and cold rest markers.

reward.finding: The hearth mark preserves different needs; warmth is not a universal welcome.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Compare the reflected buds and landing sketch with the dated shelter pages.
Inspect the deliberately blank spring entry; no special encounter is needed.
Tell Ena that the last keepers left space for visitors they had not yet understood.

reward.finding: The open-page mark invites new observations instead of declaring the guide finished.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Revisit the alcove and flood-bank records; compare their archived seasonal sketches.
Add a cold-perch note and a clear-landing note to the northern boards.
Show Ena a route plan that remains useful through changing weather.

reward.finding: A seasonal appendix opens optional visits from Articuno and Dragonite; neither is needed to finish the plot.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Visit one marked refuge in each settlement and inspect its new return-path board.
Give Mara the eight exit checks; the keepers agree to maintain the network.

reward.finding: The refuges reconnect as an optional network on paper; no cross-region fast travel is added. Celebi may now visit Lastwatch Shelter.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

stages.objective: Observe the spring from its quiet marker and record mixed footprints; do not chase a visitor.
Tell Ena to keep the final page open for future discoveries.

reward.finding: The optional plot ends with a maintained, unfinished guide. Mew may now visit the spring; capture is an optional epilogue.
reward.grant_policy: Idempotent; no bag item, party slot, capture, battle win, or consumable required.

text.quest.leaves_at_gate.start.speaker: Mara
lines: The berries are gone, but the basket is still here. Could you follow those little tracks?

text.quest.leaves_at_gate.complete.speaker: Mara
lines: A low door and a dry bed. Someone knew just what a tired Pokémon needed.

text.quest.bells_without_wind.start.speaker: Nell
lines: That bell rings with no breeze outside. There must be a draft taking the long way round.

text.quest.bells_without_wind.complete.speaker: Nell
lines: We can leave the little bell soft. Visitors need their naps, too.

text.quest.map_that_drinks.start.speaker: Orrin
lines: This map bends right around the hot stones. Whoever drew it was thinking of thirsty feet.

text.quest.map_that_drinks.complete.speaker: Orrin
lines: A small drink can make a very long road possible.

text.quest.waters_long_way.start.speaker: Fenn
lines: The water takes a turn here. The old footpath takes an even wider one.

text.quest.waters_long_way.complete.speaker: Fenn
lines: Now we can keep our shoes dry and leave the little pools alone.

text.quest.thread_on_breeze.start.speaker: Iva
lines: The brightest ribbon points uphill. The quiet ribbon points somewhere kinder.

text.quest.thread_on_breeze.complete.speaker: Iva
lines: A good path fits the traveler. It does not have to be the grandest one.

text.quest.lamps_below_tide.start.speaker: Tobin
lines: That lamp points out to sea, but its reflection falls right beside a door.

text.quest.lamps_below_tide.complete.speaker: Tobin
lines: We will light the walkway and leave the nests in the dark.

text.quest.six_marks_one_margin.start.speaker: Mara
lines: Six marks, and none of them says hurry. I think we have been reading a welcome book.

text.quest.six_marks_one_margin.complete.speaker: Mara
lines: Two pages are missing. They can wait until your own journey has room for them.

text.quest.warmth_beneath_frost.start.speaker: Rusk
lines: We warmed every room once. The cold-loving visitors stayed outside.

text.quest.warmth_beneath_frost.complete.speaker: Rusk
lines: There. A warm bed, a cool perch, and room to choose.

text.quest.quiet_fold.start.speaker: Ena
lines: The book stops here, but the footprints keep going.

text.quest.quiet_fold.complete.speaker: Ena
lines: Maybe the last keeper left us a turn to write.

text.quest.seasons_in_margins.start.speaker: Ena
lines: We have sketches from every season. You need not wait for the snow to learn from it.

text.quest.seasons_in_margins.complete.speaker: Ena
lines: The sky perch is clear now. Let us see who chooses to visit.

text.quest.path_for_every_visitor.start.speaker: Mara
lines: An entrance is only half a welcome. Can every visitor find the way back?

text.quest.path_for_every_visitor.comple.speaker: Mara
lines: Eight clear paths home. That is a fine thing to put in our book.

text.quest.page_left_blank.start.speaker: Ena
lines: These tracks do not all match. Let us leave enough room for a visitor we cannot name.

text.quest.page_left_blank.complete.speaker: Ena
lines: A blank page is useful. It means the next traveler has something to add.

retry.single_capture_safe.scope: One successful capture per authored encounter per save continuity; not a global species ownership limit.
retry.single_capture_safe.on_decline: Leave available and idle; the offer remains usable immediately.
retry.single_capture_safe.on_run_or_defeat: Leave persistent status available; set transient retry_pending until leaving and reentering the area or loading an out-of-battle save.
retry.single_capture_safe.on_blackout: Leave available; clear transient context and use normal base-game blackout recovery. Do not invoke a custom return warp.
retry.single_capture_safe.on_full_party_and_storage: Before battle, explain the lack of capacity and leave available. A later storage-transfer failure must also leave available without granting a duplicate.
retry.single_capture_safe.on_successful_capture: Commit ownership transfer and this encounter's captured status together. Hide only this encounter after that commit.
retry.single_capture_safe.on_load: A saved captured encounter stays captured. For an available encounter, clear transient locks and treat loading the area as fresh entry.
retry.single_capture_safe.on_trade_release_or_other_capture: Never reset captured after trading or releasing its Pokémon. Catching this species elsewhere does not resolve this encounter.
retry.single_capture_safe.duplicate_guard: Recheck encounter status before battle and before transfer; only one encounter interaction may be active.
retry.single_capture_safe.save_boundary: A pre-capture save restores pre-capture ownership and encounter state together. No anti-rollback or cross-save guarantee is claimed.
retry.single_capture_safe.implementation_status: Required behavior only. Capture/save atomicity, capacity hooks, and load recovery must be proven against a supplied lawful base before integration.

state.quest_stage_journal.description: For each quest, retain accepted status, completed stage IDs, and stage observation area IDs. Completion flags below are canonical for finished quests.

landings.landing.bramblewick.entry: Always-clear hamlet arrival strip beside the Route 20 path.
landings.landing.base.route_twenty.return: Surveyed safe tile beside the added entrance; unresolved until the base is inspected.
landings.landing.leaffold.entry: Always-clear dry corridor inside the alcove.
landings.landing.bramblewick.leaffold_exit: Always-clear strip south of the low branch; also the return fallback.

first_playable_slice.purpose: First optional implementation candidate, not a replacement for choosing the base-game starter.

layout_intent.shape: Compact loop around a berry bed; no dead-end narrow lane.
layout_intent.south: Route 20 entry and unconditional exit on a clear arrival strip.
layout_intent.west: Mara and the ledger table, with enough walking space to pass the NPC.
layout_intent.center: Berry basket clue; soft mud clue a few steps northeast.
layout_intent.north: Two-leaf marker and low branch entrance, visible from the loop.
layout_intent.east: Open path returning to the entrance; other secret entrances remain outside this first slice.
layout_intent.collision_intent: NPCs cannot occupy a landing, clue interaction tile, or the only exit route.

layout_intent.shape: One small room with a clear walking loop.
layout_intent.south: Visible physical exit and optional return sign beside it.
layout_intent.west: Shelter board, reachable without crossing the encounter interaction.
layout_intent.north: Stone leaf bed; Deerling waits in an off-path pocket.
layout_intent.east: Dry passage connecting the room back to the south exit.
layout_intent.collision_intent: Deerling is never a blocking doorway object; hiding it never changes walkability.

clue_chain.inference: Selective feeding, not a stolen basket; follow the skins toward the mud.
A small visitor walked beneath the low branch.
The opening is an old refuge entrance rather than a trap.

first_playable_slice.clue_order_policy: Narrative clues suggest a chain, but the three persistent bits may be collected in any order after acceptance. Earlier inspection shows text.leaves.before_acceptance and never makes a clue unavailable.

state_transitions.event: Accept Mara's request while the first-badge gate is true.

effects: Set that clue's bit idempotently; never clear another bit.

state_transitions.event: Interact with the low branch after all three clue bits are true.
effects: Set flag.discovered.leaffold_alcove; retain entrance access permanently.

state_transitions.event: Inspect the shelter board in the accessible alcove.
Report to Mara before shelter inspection.
effects: Give a hint; do not grant the reward.
Set flag.quest.leaves_at_gate.complete and grant the journal entry once.
Show repeat dialogue only; never grant a second reward.

first_playable_slice.state_consistency: The state and its milestone flags must be committed together. On load, completion has highest precedence, then shelter inspection, then accepted status. Repair from consistent saved milestones only; never infer a catch from quest progress.
access_invariants: No field move, held item, clock window, season, battle win, or capture is needed.
Alcove access survives quest completion and every encounter outcome.
Shelter inspection is possible before or after capture, defeat, fleeing, or declining.
Leaving, returning, or blacking out does not itself complete a quest stage.

encounter.trigger: Deliberate interaction with the visible Deerling; never automatic on map entry.
encounter.quest_relationship: The encounter is available once the alcove is open. Catching it before inspection, after completion, or never catching it does not change the quest requirements.

return_warp_intent.validation: Store only the allowed symbolic return key. Validate destination binding, walkability, and occupancy before moving the player. Missing or stale keys use the fallback landing.
return_warp_intent.physical_exit: The south doorway is always available in every quest and encounter state and uses the same validated destination.
return_warp_intent.blackout: Use ordinary base-game recovery and clear transient encounter/warp context; do not call the custom exit warp.
return_warp_intent.integration_blocker: Do not enable entry unless both physical exit and fallback landing have proven valid bindings. No base-story destination may be inferred from a numeric placeholder.

save_resume_criteria.case: Each of the eight possible clue-bit subsets, then save and reload.
save_resume_criteria.expected: Accepted status and exactly those bits survive; remaining clues can be inspected in any order.

save_resume_criteria.case: Save inside the open alcove, reload, inspect the shelter, then leave.
save_resume_criteria.expected: Entrance remains open, temporary locks are cleared, and the physical exit and return sign work.

save_resume_criteria.case: Save after inspecting the shelter but before reporting.
save_resume_criteria.expected: Mara can complete the quest once without requiring another visit or a capture.

save_resume_criteria.case: Save after completion and repeatedly revisit/report.
save_resume_criteria.expected: One journal reward; uncaptured Deerling stays available; completed milestones never regress.

save_resume_criteria.case: Capture, successfully save, reload, then trade or release the caught Pokémon.
save_resume_criteria.expected: Captured status and ownership were saved consistently; the original encounter never respawns.
